notes.title: Launching Crowdfunding for Final Chapter Production & Vocal Album
notes.content:
Finally, the production of the final chapter, Chapter 3, has commenced. Thus, we plan to conduct crowdfunding again for the production costs. However, in addition to just making the game, this time we are also planning a vocal album. Of course, the OP and ED from Chapter 1 to 2 are also scheduled to be included. Furthermore, when the crowdfunding goal is reached, we are planning to add a theme song by a deluxe artist.

[previewyoutube=ZGjqUHFZ0ro;full][/previewyoutube]

Like the last crowdfunding, we hope to set stretch goals this time as well.

We will also be providing some of the rewards from last time, and making some for new users. If you know anyone who might be interested, we would appreciate it if you could recommend them to us. If you are able to help with leaflet distribution and SNS promotion, please feel free to DM us.

◾️Crowdfunding page: [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/view/698723?utm_campaign=cp_po_share_c_msg_mypage_projects_show]https://camp-fire.jp/projects/view/698723?utm_campaign=cp_po_share_c_msg_mypage_projects_show[/url]

Future information will be posted here, so we would be grateful for your continued support. During the consecutive holidays, we aim to deliver details about the rewards and plans for next projects, so stay tuned!

We kindly ask for your support. Thank you.
